ALISAEED-1/matchmind.detail: Seeded Python possession-chain simulator with fictional clubs and three committed story fixtures. No Kaggle/Hugging Face loader found.

evidence.finding: Uses random.Random(seed) for match generation.
Three shipped seeded match scenarios are defined locally.

HamzatAbdulazeez/matchmind-studio.detail: TypeScript seeded generator is the default. An adapter can load a user-provided JSON file; its presence does not establish an official dataset source.

evidence.finding: generateMatch creates fictional teams and randomised events.
The adapter chooses a local file or synthetic generation.

Hapinam/vybe-ai.detail: A hard-coded Aurora FC versus Harbor United fixture drives replay. Optional Azure AI writes narration; it does not supply the match dataset.

evidence.finding: Local fixture defines fictional teams and explicit event rows.
Documents a local synthetic fixture without an external sports API.

SeyiBuilds/VendorIQ.detail: Ships locally generated samples in Opta-, StatsBomb-, and Wyscout-shaped formats. Vendor schemas and supported uploads are not proof of downloaded vendor datasets. No Kaggle/Hugging Face loader found.

evidence.finding: Generator exports one synthetic ground-truth timeline into three vendor shapes.
Three synthetic sample matches are shipped; Wyscout-shaped imports are also described.

Simplify4Me2/goal-getter.detail: C# generator uses the fixture ID as its random seed and a locally defined fictional squad. The repository is early, rather than a live external-data integration.

evidence.finding: Events are generated with new Random(fixture.MatchId).
The single fixture and its player names are defined in source.

achand280606/Shift11.detail: Python seeded scenario generator produces formation-aware events and writes data/match_001.json. No external tracking dataset is consumed in the inspected source.

evidence.finding: generate_match accepts a seed and synthetic formation/scenario settings.
The documented command writes the generated local match file.

aj0khi/soccer-hackathon-project.detail: TypeScript generator produces a seeded momentum-shift scenario. The optional Event Hubs adapter is a transport integration, not evidence of an external football dataset.

evidence.finding: generateSyntheticMatch creates seeded event sequences.
The local generator remains available alongside the optional Event Hubs adapter.

audioreworkvisions/touchline.detail: Custom seeded JavaScript simulator creates fictional events and illustrative player tracking. The committed JSONL sample is its output. Vision uses the synthetic renderer rather than real broadcast footage.

evidence.finding: generateMatch builds a seeded event stream.
Data card explains synthetic provenance and explicitly excludes real match feeds.
Vision reads rendered pixel arrays; player identity uses synthetic colours.

devgupta-9/reactcoach-11.detail: Rust engine uses editable fictional player profiles and deterministic spatial scenarios; it also replays locally supplied synthetic match events. It is not trained on a football dataset.

evidence.finding: Spatial rollout uses explicitly synthetic physical conventions.
The example serialises a fictional demo request.
Event replay states that no external sports feeds are used.

faisalbasra/match-storyteller.detail: Planning documents propose seeded synthetic fixtures and a Python statistics reducer. No implemented data pipeline or dataset is present.

evidence.finding: Repository explicitly describes planning / pre-implementation status.
Planned match-data layer is a seeded synthetic fixture.

kamal-saleh/SignalFlow.detail: README-only attention-engine concept listing synthetic match data; no source, generator, or dataset is present.

evidence.finding: Synthetic football data is listed as proposed technology.

natagowai/matchmind-ai.detail: The inspected API contains the default weather-forecast example and the frontend is a starter React/Vite interface. No football ingestion, generator, or dataset was found in source.

evidence.finding: Default /weatherforecast endpoint returns randomly generated weather.
Frontend is a starter app, rather than match-data integration.

s70241963-afk/Sushmitha.detail: Two starter ZIPs include small synthetic JSON matches: one has 5 events, the other 8. These are example fixtures, not a real football dataset. Attachments were inspected without running their code.

evidence.finding: Starter code is linked as attachments, outside the repository tree.

swarupe7/microsoft_dev_hackathon.detail: In-browser event generator uses Math.random and locally defined fictional teams. It is stochastic, rather than a reproducible seeded generator, despite a seeded-looking comment.

evidence.finding: chance() and player selection call Math.random.
Fictional club names and players are local source constants.

timmytrace/pl-insights-engine.detail: C# MatchSimulator generates events and tracking from integer seeds. Shipped CSV/JSONL data is generated locally; Azure AI narrates the derived facts.

evidence.finding: The simulator initialises its own seeded random generator.
Data card documents generated fictional matches and reproducible CSV/JSONL exports.

timsheldon1/matchday-crew.detail: Node generator uses a match/club/seed key and ships one generated JSON sample. AI agents add interpretation and multilingual speech, rather than sourcing match data.

evidence.finding: generateMatch creates its RNG from match seed and fictional club identifiers.
CLI generates a local JSON match and streams those events.

vasureddyuppunuri/Inside--the-game-Tacti.detail: README and licence only. The description proposes synthetic telemetry, but no data implementation or dataset is present.

evidence.finding: Only the intended synthetic-event concept is described.

vishnugovind10/matchlens.detail: Loads a committed JSONL sequence with fictional Arsenal/Liverpool events. Explanations use a deterministic fallback; what-if results are conditional synthetic projections.

evidence.finding: DATA_PATH points to the local synthetic_events.jsonl fixture.
load_events reads that JSONL file.
Fixture provenance and its baseline/high-press phases are documented.
